description: Get address by name with vault references resolved. Entry values starting with 'local://' are automatically fetched from vault and replaced with actual secret values. Example: 'local://api_keys/openai' -> actual API key

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Full address record with vault references resolved: address (object), entries (list with 'local://' references replaced by actual secret values)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves an address with vault references automatically resolved, replacing 'local://category/key' references with actual secret values
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: no address registered with this name. VaultError: one or more vault references could not be resolved. PermissionError: insufficient access to requested secrets.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: use 'search' to find addresses or 'register' to create. For vault errors: verify the vault reference format (local://category/key) and that the secret exists. For permission errors: check vault access permissions.
